why: S-1 of the adopted eligibility ladder is 'enrolled under the prospective cohort protocol'. The adopted base lock's /cohort_protocol field names 'Live Signal Engine/GST_PROSPECTIVE_COHORT_PROTOCOL_v1.0_DRAFT.md'. If cohort protocol v1.2 is adopted without amending that reference, S-1 would continue to point at a superseded draft and the ladder would test enrollment against the wrong document.
proposed_value_note: The SHA-256 is deliberately left unset. It must be computed from the exact bytes being adopted at the moment of signature, so that adoption binds specific content and not a moving path.
binding_condition: This amendment and GST_PROSPECTIVE_COHORT_PROTOCOL_v1.2_DRAFT.md must be signed TOGETHER. Neither takes effect alone: adopting the protocol without this amendment leaves S-1 pointing at v1.0; adopting this amendment without the protocol points S-1 at an unadopted document.
what_this_amendment_does_not_do: It changes no statistical rule; D1-D16 are untouched.
It changes no eligibility gate, threshold, formula or ordering. S-1's TEXT is unchanged; only the document it resolves to moves.
It does not close F5, authorize collection, or activate anything.
It does not edit the adopted lock in place. The current value is preserved verbatim above.

authorization.prospective_only: Effective from the approval timestamp. Reclassifies no earlier event and creates no pre-approval deadline.
